NFIDD is a set of freely available, open-source materials for learning about
**nowcasting and forecasting infectious disease dynamics**. Everything here is
provided under the permissive [MIT License](https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT)
for teaching, learning, and adaptation.

We welcome all users to the
[discussion board](https://github.com/nfidd/nfidd/discussions) and welcome all
forms of [contributions, additions and suggestions](https://github.com/nfidd/nfidd/issues)
for improving the materials.

## Courses & resources

::: {.grid}

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
### [Main course](https://nfidd.github.io/nfidd/){target="_self"}
The core course and living resource: nowcasting and forecasting infectious
disease dynamics, from delay distributions and the renewal equation through to
forecast evaluation and ensembles.
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
### [Understanding, evaluating & improving forecasts](https://nfidd.github.io/ueifid/){target="_self"}
Material on understanding, evaluating, and improving forecasts of infectious
disease burden.
:::

:::

## Taught courses

::: {.grid}

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4}
### [SISMID](https://nfidd.github.io/sismid/){target="_self"}
The combined nowcasting and forecasting course taught at SISMID.
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4}
### [SISMID · Nowcasting](https://nfidd.github.io/sismid-nowcasting/){target="_self"}
Nowcasting of infectious disease dynamics (SISMID, first half of the week).
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4}
### [SISMID · Forecasting](https://nfidd.github.io/sismid-forecasting/){target="_self"}
Forecasting and evaluation of infectious disease dynamics (SISMID, second half
of the week).
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4}
### [EMBL-EBI](https://nfidd.github.io/EMBL-EBI/){target="_self"}
Nowcasting of infectious disease dynamics, taught at EMBL-EBI.
:::

:::
